warrant.statement: Conditional hypothesis: exact native physical non-person noun definitions denote their own object/kind rather than the current speaker or addressee. Under the approved person-reference-only coordinates, these defining contents are orthogonal to I and YOU. Sentence reference binding is separate. Person ancestry is excluded to reserve personal, address and pronominal readings. This scope is not yet independently audited, and other native ambiguities or counterexamples may require refinement.
